=== FILE: src/App.js ===
import { getObjectEntries, createObjectEntry } from './services/liferayApi';

const OBJECT_ERC = 'LIBRARY_BOOK';
const FORMAT_ERC = 'PL_BOOK_FORMAT';

export default function App() {
    const load = async () => {
        const books = await getObjectEntries(OBJECT_ERC, '', 1, 1);
        const formats = await getObjectEntries(
            `/headless-admin-list-type/v1.0/list-type-definitions/by-external-reference-code/${FORMAT_ERC}/list-type-entries`
        );
        await createObjectEntry('LIBRARY_LOAN', {title: 'Dune'});
        return [books, formats];
    };
    return <div className="container" onClick={load}>Library</div>;
}
=== END FILE ===
